item.title: ००८ रामेण वालिवधनिश्चयः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Sugreeva gives a report to Rama about his plight for fear of Vali, who made his own brother an enemy and abducted Sugreeva’s wife. Rama asks Sugreeva to inform him about the real cause of enmity, so that he can decide correctly. Sugreeva narrates his woeful condition.

भागसूचना
  1. सुग्रीवका श्रीरामसे अपना दुःख निवेदन करना और श्रीरामका उन्हें आश्वासन देते हुए दोनों भाइयोंमें वैर होनेका कारण पूछना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Delighted by Rāma’s oath, Sugrīva deems himself blessed by the gods to have won a fire-witnessed friend with whose aid even the sovereignty of heaven could be gained.

item.title: ००९ सुग्रीवेण वैरकारणकथनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Sugreeva reports the incident that sparked off the indignation and ire of Vali towards Sugreeva. Sugreeva describes to Rama about the strength and heartless nature of Vali, with a kind of indirect portrayal of his enemy’s capabilities.

भागसूचना
  1. सुग्रीवका श्रीरामचन्द्रजीको वालीके साथ अपने वैर होनेका कारण बताना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Sugrīva recounts how Vālin succeeded their father on the throne while he served him humbly, until the demon Māyāvin—locked in a feud over a woman—challenged Vālin at midnight.

item.title: ०१० वालिना सुग्रीवनिर्भर्त्सनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Sugreeva informs Rama that Vali could not be appeased in spite of repeated requests as he is resolved to accept Sugreeva as an enemy. Vali banishes Sugreeva from the kingdom with the same thinking.

भागसूचना
  1. भाईके साथ वैरका कारण बतानेके प्रसङ्गमें सुग्रीवका वालीको मनाने और वालीद्वारा अपने निष्कासित होनेका वृत्तान्त सुनाना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Sugrīva recounts how he sought to propitiate the furious Vālin upon his return, offering the royal parasol and explaining why he sealed the cavern and re-entered Kiṣkindhā.

item.title: ०११ वालिपराक्रमवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Sugreeva narrates Vali’s bravery and intrepidity in fighting and how he fought with a mountainous buffalo demon named Dundubhi. Also narrated is the curse of Sage Matanga that prohibited Vali’s entrance into Mt. Rishyamuka area.In order to imbibe confidence in Sugreeva, Rama starts to show his valour and might.

भागसूचना
  1. सुग्रीवके द्वारा वालीके पराक्रमका वर्णन— वालीका दुन्दुभि दैत्यको मारकर उसकी लाशको मतङ्गवनमें फेंकना, मतङ्गमुनिका वालीको शाप देना, श्रीरामका दुन्दुभिके अस्थिसमूहको दूर फेंकना और सुग्रीवका उनसे साल-भेदनके लिये आग्रह करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Praising Rāma’s fiery arrows, Sugrīva asks him to hear attentively of Vālin’s superhuman might: pacing the four oceans before sunrise, tossing mountain peaks, and snapping hardwood trees.

item.title: ०१२ रामकृतसप्ततालच्छेदनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Rama to imbue confidence in Sugreeva hurtles his arrow that penetrates seven sala trees and also the subterranean planes of earth and returns into his quiver. Sugreeva obliging the prowess of Rama submits himself to Rama, who encourages Sugreeva to challenge Vali for a duel. Accordingly a duel ensues wherein Vali assaults Sugreeva and chases him off. Battered and belittled, Sugreeva implores upon Rama why he did not come to his rescue. Rama apologetically states that he could not make out difference between the two brothers for they are alike. Rama asks Sugreeva to wear a garland and again challenge Vali, so with that identification of garland he could aim his arrow at the other dueller. Again they all advance towards Kishkindha for the duel with Vali.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामके द्वारा सात साल-वृक्षोंका भेदन, श्रीरामकी आज्ञासे सुग्रीवका किष्किन्धामें आकर वालीको ललकारना और युद्धमें उससे पराजित होकर मतंगवनमें भाग जाना, वहाँ श्रीरामका उन्हें आश्वासन देना और गलेमें पहचानके लिये गजपुष्पीलता डालकर उन्हें पुनः युद्धके लिये भेजना

item.title: ०१३ सप्तजनाश्रमवर्णनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

After encouraging Sugreeva to challenge Vali for a second time duly wearing a flower garland as a mark of identification between the two brothers, Rama and others proceed to Kishkindha. On their way they chance to see a divine hermitage called sapta jana aashrama ‘Hermitage of Seven Sages.’ On worshipping it they proceed to Kishkindha.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम आदिका मार्गमें वृक्षों, विविध जन्तुओं, जलाशयों तथा सप्तजन आश्रमका दूरसे दर्शन करते हुए पुनः किष्किन्धापुरीमें पहुँचना

item.title: ०१४ सुग्रीवेण वालिनं प्रति युद्धाह्वानम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Sugreeva again requests Rama to ascertain whether he is prepared to eliminate Vali this time. Rama assures Sugreeva that he will not deviate from what he has promised, and he never would, and asks Sugreeva to challenge Vali by way of inviting him for a duel. Sugreeva blares out inciting Vali to the duel.

भागसूचना
  1. वाली-वधके लिये श्रीरामका आश्वासन पाकर सुग्रीवकी विकट गर्जना

item.title: ०१५ तारोपदेशः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Lady Tara is entered here. She is the granddaughter of Brihaspati, the Jupiter and wife of Vali and she is one of the exemplary females in this epic. She is entered only thrice in the vast of this epic, presently here, next at the fall of Vali and later to pacify the ire of Lakshmana. But her personality for analytical intelligence does not exit from the minds of readers. Here she advises Vali not to confront Sugreeva, as long as Rama stands guard to him. Further she says after a logical discourse and reasons, why not Sugreeva be made the Prince Regent of Kishkindha, even at this juncture, where she foresees a calamity to Vali. But Vali, maddened in his intellect by his brawny might slights her far fetching advice.

भागसूचना
  1. सुग्रीवकी गर्जना सुनकर वालीका युद्धके लिये निकलना और ताराका उसे रोककर सुग्रीव और श्रीरामके साथ मैत्री कर लेनेके लिये समझाना

item.title: ०१६ वालिवधः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Vali dismissing Tara’s words, who is dissuading him to confront Rama, starts out to fight out Sugreeva. A ghastly fight ensues in which Vali depletes Sugreeva’s strength by the boon and Indra’s chest-plate, and thus Sugreeva seeks Rama’s help. Rama shoots his arrow which hits Vali on chest, but does not render him dead immediately. Thus that great mighty and unassailable Vali is brought down to ground.

भागसूचना
  1. वालीका ताराको डाँटकर लौटाना और सुग्रीवसे जूझना तथा श्रीरामके बाणसे घायल होकर पृथ्वीपर गिरना

item.title: ०१७ वालिकृतरामनिन्दा
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Rama’s arrow hits Vali on chest and Vali fallen down. But Vali is not dead yet. When Rama and Lakshmana approach dying Vali, he questions the propriety of Rama in killing him. Vali’s questioning explicitly is straightforward befitting to the defeated mighty Vanara King. But implicitly, there are ancient commentaries that deduce many more meanings in picturising Vali as a devotee of Rama, who wanted to die at the hand of Rama, like Viraadha and others, as a means of salvation.

भागसूचना
  1. वालीका श्रीरामचन्द्रजीको फटकारना

item.title: ०१८ रामेण वालिवधसमर्थनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Rama explains to dying Vali as to why he gave such a punishment. Rama categorically explains all the question put by Vali in the last chapter from the viewpoint of scriptures that lay down principle for sanaatana dharma, eternal tradition, as well as raaja dharma, king’s duty. Vali finally concludes that there is someone superior to him and thus seeks refuge in Rama.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका वालीकी बातका उत्तर देते हुए उसे दिये गये दण्डका औचित्य बताना,वालीका निरुत्तर होकर भगवान् से अपने अपराधके लिये क्षमा माँगते हुए अङ्गदकी रक्षाके लिये प्रार्थना करना और श्रीरामका उसे आश्वासन देना

item.title: ०१९ तारागमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Lady Tara rushes out to reach her slain husband while the monkey generals seek of her to anoint Angada as king immediately or leave Kishkindha, for Sugreeva and his men may come occupying the city. She chides their advises away and proceeds to meet Vali. She arrives at that place, sees Rama and his brother Lakshmana, her husband Vali and his brother Sugreeva. She faints and wails for the departing soul of Vali.

भागसूचना
  1. अङ्गदसहित ताराका भागे हुए वानरोंसे बात करके वालीके समीप आना और उसकी दुर्दशा देखकर रोना

item.title: ०२० ताराविलापः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Tara’s lamentation for her departing husband Vali. She unlike other forest beings who just forsake the dead partner, weeps bitterly for Vali and holds Sugreeva and Rama responsible for the untimely death of Vali. The common nature of humans is portrayed through the Vanara empress.

भागसूचना
  1. ताराका विलाप
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Moon-faced Tārā embraces the fallen Vālin, who lies like an uprooted tree, and laments that her lord forsakes her to cleave to his rival bride, the bare earth.

item.title: ०२१ हनुमता तारासान्त्वनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Hanuma tries to console Tara. He asserts that Angada will not be looked down. Though Vali is put to his plight, Hanuma says, that Tara alone is the empress to lead Kishkindha kingdom. But Tara prefers self-immolation along with her husband Vali.

भागसूचना
  1. हनुमान् जी का ताराको समझाना और ताराका पतिके अनुगमनका ही निश्चय करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Hanumān, the leader of the monkey troop, gently consoles the fallen Tārā with teachings on karmic retribution, the bubble-like fragility of the body, and her duty toward Prince Aṅgada.

item.title: ०२२ वालिमरणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Vali recovers from his swoon and gives his parting messages to Sugreeva and Angada. He also gives his miraculous pendant, given by his father Indra, to Sugreeva and asks him to assume authority of Kishkindha kingdom, for he won it in this fight. Angada is advised to conduct appropriately for he is becoming a father-less son now. Then Vali breathes his last to pave the way for Seetha’s search.

भागसूचना
  1. वालीका सुग्रीव और अङ्गदसे अपने मनकी बात कहकर प्राणोंको त्याग देना

item.title: ०२३ ताराशोकः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Tara’s lamentation is narrated in here. Seeing at her departed husband Vali, Tara pitiably wails for his demise as any ordinary woman would.

भागसूचना
  1. ताराका विलाप
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Kissing the face of the fallen monkey king, the world-renowned Tārā reproaches the silent Vālin for embracing the stony earth instead of her and ignoring his subjects’ cries.

item.title: ०२४ सुग्रीवविलापः-तारासान्त्वनं च
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Sugreeva and Tara lament Vali’s death. Sugreeva seeks permission of Rama to enter the funeral pyre of his brother Vali to self-immolate himself for his wrongdoing in getting his own brother killed. Tara asks Rama to kill her with the same arrow with which Vali is killed, so that she too can go to heavens to meet her husband.

A word about this chapter. The bardic tradition is in the habit of including everything, while the critical editions exclude anything arbitrary. This chapter is excluded in the critical editions, but traditional versions retained it, and all publications publish this. The scholars have also said that all the forty-four verses in here have no stamp of Valmiki, the verbiage and verbosity are heightened, even the meter is overfilled, and even the word positioning does not yield proper meaning. Even so, all are retained in all publications. However, it may be mentioned that if some Valmiki Jr. written and included this chapter, it should have been ages before, but not in the known ages, because Dharmaakuutam, Govindaraja and others have commentaries on chapter. In all the commentaries an exhaustive commentary is there on two verses uttered by Tara, which is included here also.

भागसूचना
  1. सुग्रीवका शोकमग्न होकर श्रीरामसे प्राणत्यागके लिये आज्ञा माँगना, ताराका श्रीरामसे अपने वधके लिये प्रार्थना करना और श्रीरामका उसे समझाना

item.title: ०२५ रामसान्त्वनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book IV : Kishkindha Kanda - The Empire of Holy Monkeys

Rama hurries up Sugreeva to proceed with the funeral ceremony of Vali instead of sitting around the body and wailing endlessly. Rama tersely tells about living being’s dependency on the eternal Time, Fate and the Absolute. Then Sugreeva takes charge of the situation and arranges for the monarchical funeral to Vali. At the final departure of her husband, Tara again laments. Ultimately Vali’s body is committed to fire for his voyage to heavens on a remote avenue.

भागसूचना
  1. लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका सुग्रीव, तारा और अङ्गदको समझाना तथा वालीके दाह-संस्कारके लिये आज्ञा प्रदान करना, फिर तारा आदिसहित सब वानरोंका वालीके शवको श्मशानभूमिमें ले जाकर अङ्गदके द्वारा उसका दाह-संस्कार कराना और उसे जलाञ्जलि देना
